caveats: Region = the 60x60 dataset grid points (0.02-deg grid) inside the inclusive bounds (lat 59.06-60.24 N, lon 21.26-22.44 E); 3290 of 3600 cells had finite SST on all 92 target days and were analysed as sea cells. Per-cell thresholds/climatology: 90th percentile (hazen = Hyndman-Fan type 5 = MATLAB default) and mean of every +/-5-calendar-day window around each 1992-2002 baseline occurrence of the day of year, including the 5-day extensions beyond the baseline (1991-12-27..1991-12-31, 2003-01-01..2003-01-05); 121 pool values per cell and day of year (all pools full, no NaNs); day-of-year 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61; both fields smoothed with a 31-day centred circular moving mean; all computations in float64. Per-cell MHW = run of >=5 consecutive days with SST (kelvin) >= threshold; MHWs separated by 1-2 non-hot days were joined and the gap days included; 3473 per-cell MHWs in total, every sea cell had at least one. One regional event: 2014-07-19..2014-08-20 (33 consecutive active days; all sea cells in MHW 2014-07-25..2014-08-14).
